title: Evacuation software and new evacuation zones
summary: The agency said in May 2026 that it is working with large landowners so private roads can be used during evacuations. Back in 2024, it bought two evacuation software tools and said they should be running by January 1, 2025. In November 2024, new evacuation zones might go online January 1, though that date could move.

timeline.text: The agency said it is working with large landowners so private roads can be used during evacuations.
He said new evacuation zones may go online January 1, a date that could move.
The administrator said the software should be running by January 1, 2025.
The administrator said the partner list for the evacuation software will go out this week, followed by training, an implementation plan and a public education plan.
The administrator said the agency bought two evacuation software tools.

fromCommunityMeetings.quote: If there's private roads or anything that we might have to use, we'll try as best as we can to make sure our officers drive those routes first.
fromCommunityMeetings.about: Describes how police check private roads before sending evacuees on them.

source.title: Kula Community Meeting: Fire Preparedness July 23, 2024

fromCommunityMeetings.quote: I can click on zone 1, 2, and 3 that puts them in imminent danger and or red. Kind of notification that you guys need to move out now. There's a danger coming from this particular direction. I need you guys to evacuate.
fromCommunityMeetings.about: Explains how the new zone-based evacuation software lets MEMA put specific zones on evacuate, standby or advisory status quickly.

source.title: Kula Community Meeting: Fire Preparedness July 23, 2024

fromCommunityMeetings.quote: So, we would need to get some sort of agreement with Pukulani Association to allow a right of entry for people to evacuate on their property.
fromCommunityMeetings.about: Shows that a second evacuation route out of Lower Pukalani depends on an access agreement with a private landowner.

source.title: Kula Community Meeting: Fire Preparedness July 23, 2024

fromCommunityMeetings.quote: It also will identify the gap or the deficiency in evacuation routes, which would allow us to prioritize extensions of roads, connections and or additions to the road.
fromCommunityMeetings.about: Says the community evacuation modeling software will reveal weak evacuation routes and help prioritize road improvements.

source.title: Kula Community Meeting: Fire Preparedness July 23, 2024
